officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: District Inspector Land Records, Valsad; city/district land-record custodian
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official district page identifies the Valsad DILR office and says it measures fields, updates land records, and prepares property cards with NA orders and Gamthan Mojni. It gives the Valsad office address and contact details.

Official page documents state responsibility for survey, settlement and city-survey matters and links the public AnyRoR rural RoR and e-Milkat property-card services. This is state-level custody, not proof of an open vector feed.
